title: This Portfolio Website
description: A static, single-page portfolio showcasing my education, experience, skills, and coursework, with light and dark themes and a responsive layout. Features an interactive 3D lanyard badge, an animated particle background, a filterable class list, and a project carousel with detail popups generated from JSON data. Built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and three.js using Vite, with deployment to Github Pages.

title: Minnesota Sports Blog
description: A full-stack sports blog where Minnesota fans can share posts and discuss the Vikings, Wild, Timberwolves, and Twins. Features user accounts with bcrypt password hashing, session-based login, admin moderation, team categories, and full CRUD functionality for posts and comments. Built with Node.js, Express, Pug templating, and a MySQL database hosted on Aiven, and deployed to Render. NOTE: Loading the site may take a few seconds.

title: Drone Simulation
description: A 3D simulation where users schedule package deliveries across the University of Minnesota campus. Features selectable pathfinding algorithms, dynamic package handoffs between drones, and automatic battery recharging. Built in C++ using Factory, Observer, and Strategy design patterns, with Docker for containerization and Jira, GitHub, and UML supporting development within a four-person Agile team.

title: Sports Memorabilia Website
description: A full-stack mock store where fans can order Minnesota collectibles like signed jerseys, game-used gear, and more. Features order placement with running price totals, live order tracking with a countdown to cancel or change shipping, shipping history, automatic status updates, and an order dashboard with search and status filters. Built with Node.js, Express, Pug templating, and a MySQL database hosted on Aiven, and deployed to Render. NOTE: Loading the site may take a few seconds.

title: Earthquake Visualization
description: An interactive visualization of global earthquakes from 1905–2007, featuring smooth transitions between a 2D map and a 3D globe. Animates earthquake activity over time, using marker size and color to represent magnitude. Built with TypeScript and GopherGfx using NASA Earth imagery and USGS earthquake data, and deployed to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.

title: Artistic Rendering
description: An interactive 3D model viewer showcasing lighting and shading techniques, including Gouraud, Phong, cartoon shading with silhouette outlines, and normal mapping for detailed surfaces. Built with custom GLSL shaders, TypeScript, and GopherGfx, and deployed to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.

title: So You Think Ants Can Dance
description: An interactive animation project that brings dancing characters to life using Carnegie Mellon motion capture data. Features custom character models, skeletal animation, and smooth transitions between idle poses and user-selected dance moves. Built with TypeScript using hierarchical scene graphs and matrix transformations, and deployed to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.

title: A World Made of Drawings
description: An interactive world building program that turns mouse drawings into sky artwork, standing objects, and terrain with hills and valleys. Built with TypeScript using ray casting, intersection testing, and dynamic mesh editing, and deployed to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.

title: Marble Racing
description: A 3D racing game where players control a marble through obstacle filled tracks while competing against other marbles. Features simulated gravity, friction, collision handling, and camera-relative movement. Built with TypeScript and GopherGfx, using Node.js and npm for development, and deployed to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.

title: Castle Defense
description: A 2D tower defense game where players strategically place defensive blocks to protect a portal from incoming enemies. Features physics-based movement, sound effects, and collision detection. Built with TypeScript using Node.js and npm for development, and deployed to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.

title: Election Software
description: A command-line election tool that counts ballots from CSV files and determines the winners of Plurality, STV, and Multiple Vote elections. Features Droop quota calculation, fair tie-breaking, multi-file ballot uploads, and an audit report of every election. Built in C++ with Google Test, a Node.js and Express upload server, and Doxygen, by a four-person Agile team.

title: Contact Manager
description: A command-line contact manager that stores names, phone numbers, and zip codes in named contact logs. Features a hash table with linked-list buckets for fast lookups, input validation, and saving and loading logs as both text and binary files. Built in C with manual memory management, compiled with gcc and Make, and verified against an automated test suite.

title: Chess
description: A two-player chess game played in the terminal, with the board drawn using Unicode chess pieces. Features legal move checking for every piece, turn enforcement, pawn promotion, starting positions loaded from FEN notation, and ending the game when a king is captured. Built in Java using object-oriented design, together with a partner.

title: Minesweeper
description: A terminal version of Minesweeper with small, medium, and large boards and color-coded cells. Features a guaranteed safe first move, flag placement, a debug mode that reveals the full board, and automatic clearing of empty regions. Built in Java with custom generic stack and queue classes powering the flood-fill reveals, together with a partner.
from: CSCI 1933 - Intro to Algorithms & Data Structures

title: Lisp Interpreter
description: An interpreter for a subset of Lisp that reads programs from files and runs them, including a symbolic algebra equation solver. Features a lexical scanner, a recursive descent parser, environment-based evaluation, closures through lambda, and built-in primitives like define, if, car, cdr, and cons. Built in OCaml using modules, variant types, and functional programming.
